items.title: Walmart delivers mixed results on mid-decade sustainability goals
items.summary: Walmart fell short on many of its environmental pledges for 2025, an outcome it foreshadowed in December 2024.

items.title: GHG Protocol adjusts standards update timelines
items.summary: The Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol is extending the timeline for big updates to its corporate carbon accounting standards, which haven’t seen major revisions for more than a decade.

items.title: 9 must-read books for sustainability pros (2026 edition)
items.summary: In 1962, marine biologist Rachel Carson published “Silent Spring,” her meticulously documented case against the indiscriminate use of pesticides.

items.title: Is incrementalism enough in a systems-change world?
items.summary: Here’s a question that’s been keeping me up at night: Are sustainability professionals — all of us, individually and collectively — working at the wrong level?

items.title: Ofgem targets speculative data centres to unlock grid capacity
items.summary: The regulator aims to free up more space in the grid connections queue for investment-ready, viable projects, as MPs launch an inquiry into the UK's data centre future.

items.title: GHG Protocol outlines next phase of carbon accounting standards
items.summary: The Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol has announced key updates to its standards overhaul, including confirming plans to create a harmonised framework with the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

items.title: Why better data is leading to more companies making sustainability metric adjustments
items.summary: Research from Deloitte has found that more than two-thirds of FTSE 100 companies adjusted their climate and sustainability metrics last year, pointing to better data, rather than a step back in ambitions.

items.title: Most countries failed to meet target on nature-harming subsidies, study finds
items.summary: According to new research from Carbon Brief, 84% of nations failed to identify all of their subsidies that could be “harmful” to biodiversity by the 2025 deadline.

items.title: The hidden risk in waiting to buy carbon credits
items.summary: Most companies have spent the past decade building climate strategies. The next challenge isn't setting the target – it's securing the resources needed to achieve it.

items.title: Report: Global battery energy storage set to grow six-fold by 2030
items.summary: To support ongoing renewables expansion, the battery energy storage market is expected to grow six-fold worldwide by the end of the decade, with China and the US leading the charge.
